scrape-formats.response-warnings-hints.evidence: 0a25fb8: the ladder adds a low_content_yield warning to a thin http answer that stays the run's answer, on the ladder_best_kept path (the quality hop ended improved: false) and on the finish paths (no further rung was permitted: fastMode, an http-only policy, no browser rung; or the browser rung failed without a page), with the http rung's own token count and confidence ('found no main content' on an empty_unverified shell); every response with warnings carries warning, their messages joined with a space (full and compact scrape responses, batch items, crawl pages, /fc data.warning, which so passes the native warnings through for the first time); agentHints (hints.ts, a fixed table) gains the low-yield row (waitFor up to 60000 ms or a longer timeout with the browser lane available, left out under fastMode) and a file row (what the markdown is). Live (record F1 to F3, G1): books.toscrape.com and scrapethissite's ajax page answer with no warnings, warning or agentHints key (the ajax page's 208 tokens at confidence 1 trip no quality signal, as the plan foresaw); IMF answered 403 on the http rung and a rendered page on the browser rung, so no warning (the rule holds; the outcome is not one of the plan's three); quotes.toscrape.com/js/ under fastMode carries client_rendered_suspected and low_content_yield ('The http lane found no main content at confidence 0; the browser lane was not available to this request.'), the joined warning string and the fastMode hint. Tests: bench ladder.test.ts, api hints.test.ts, structured.test.ts and app.test.ts (an http-only engine on the shell fixture, /fc), contracts firecrawl.test.ts. Known leftover: the browser rung raises no quality signal, so a thin rendered answer (IMF: 226 tokens at extraction confidence 0) is success without a warning; no screenshot_unavailable hint yet (it arrives with the screenshot format).

crawl-batch.ignore-query-parameters.evidence: cb8ac92: ignoreQueryParameters drops the whole query from every canonical URL (canonicalizeUrl ignoreQuery); the first variant seen is fetched (its url keeps the query, its canonicalUrl does not), later variants are refused as duplicates with collapsedInto and counted as collapsed, with up to 20 {url, into} samples in links_offered; a resume keys getStepByCanonicalUrl on the same canonical. crawl-batch.deduplicate-similar-urls.evidence: cb8ac92: deduplicateSimilarURLs (default true) keys the frontier's visited set by a visit key without scheme, leading www., trailing slash and index.html/.htm/.php; folded variants are collapsed with samples, the step's canonicalUrl stays a real URL; the rawBodySha256 backstop keeps status duplicate, counts in discovery.duplicateContent, and such pages are left out of GET /v1/crawl/:id/pages unless includeDuplicates=true (SDK getCrawlPages, MCP get_crawl_pages) and out of /fc status data while total counts them. crawl-batch.crawl-entire-domain.evidence: cb8ac92: crawlEntireDomain (default false) keeps links on the seed host inside the seed's path subtree (its directory, the directory of the file it names, or itself plus /; a redirect of the seed adds the final URL's subtree), refused as subtree_denied and counted as subtreeDenied; true follows the whole host; /fc maps v1 allowBackwardLinks and v2 crawlEntireDomain. Tests: packages/runtime/test/frontier.test.ts, packages/api/test/app.test.ts, files.test.ts, firecrawl.test.ts.
